notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE AVAILABLE NOW! - large maps, no boundaries, simulation mode, and others
notes.content:
This update brings you the major improvements previously available in Beta branch. As there were not any noteable issues reported, the patch goes public and we hope to improve your gameplay experience.
It takes longer to proceed as we had to recover from bankruptcy of our publisher bitComposer.

The update improves a lot of issues which were pointed out by players, namely:
1. Increased size of the maps and removed boundaries
2. Added simulation mode for airplanes
3. Changed control scheme 
4. Reworked gameplay style, particles, HUD
5. AI
and really countless of other fixes.

I hope you will enjoy the update!

Have fun!

tags.feature: 1. Increased size of the maps and removed boundaries
